articles.title: Wie nutzt man GPT-6.1 Sol API
articles.excerpt: Um die GPT-6.1 Sol API aufzurufen, senden Sie eine POST-Anfrage an https://api.openai.com/v1/responses mit "model": "gpt-6.1-sol" und Ihrem Schlüssel als Bearer-Token. Die Kosten liegen bei denselben…
articles.body: Um die GPT-6.1 Sol API aufzurufen, senden Sie eine POST-Anfrage an https://api.openai.com/v1/responses mit "model": "gpt-6.1-sol" und Ihrem Schlüssel als Bearer-Token. Die Kosten liegen bei denselben 2 $ für Eingaben und 10 $ für Ausgaben pro Million Token wie bei GPT-6 Sol, und die gecachte Eingabe sinkt von 0,20 $ auf 0,10 $. Die Migration von gpt-6-sol ist größtenteils ein String-Austausch. Die wichtigste Änderung betrifft den Aufwand: GPT-6.1 Sol akzeptiert weder none noch minimal , daher müssen diese Anfragen auf low umgestellt werden. Apidog heute testen OpenAI hat GPT-6.1 Sol am DevDay am 29. September 2026 veröffentlicht. Der DevDay 2026 Rückblick behandelt die anderen Veröffentlichungen, und Was ist GPT-6.1 Sol behandelt die Benchmarks detailliert.

articles.body: Để gọi API GPT-6.1 Sol, gửi yêu cầu POST đến https://api.openai.com/v1/responses với "model": "gpt-6.1-sol" và API key dưới dạng Bearer token. Giá niêm yết giữ nguyên ở mức 2 đô la đầu vào và 10 đô la đầu ra cho mỗi triệu token như GPT-6 Sol, nhưng đầu vào đã cache giảm từ 0,20 đô la xuống 0,10 đô la. Khi di chuyển từ gpt-6-sol , thay đổi chính là model ID và mức reasoning.effort : GPT-6.1 Sol không hỗ trợ none hoặc minimal , vì vậy cần ánh xạ các yêu cầu này sang low . Dùng thử Apidog ngay hôm nay OpenAI phát hành GPT-6.1 Sol tại DevDay ngày 29 tháng 9 năm 2026. Xem tổng hợp DevDay 2026 và bài viết GPT-6.1 Sol là gì để biết thêm bối cảnh và điểm chuẩn.

articles.title: Stop Putting Secrets in Environment Variables: Practical systemd-creds on Linux
articles.excerpt: Passwords in Environment= lines, API tokens in world-readable unit drop-ins, and EnvironmentFile=/etc/myapp.env that every process on the host can cat once it gets a shell — that pattern still shows u…
articles.body: Passwords in Environment= lines, API tokens in world-readable unit drop-ins, and EnvironmentFile=/etc/myapp.env that every process on the host can cat once it gets a shell — that pattern still shows up in homelab and production units alike. systemd has a better primitive: credentials . They are limited-size binary or text blobs that the service manager loads at activation time, decrypts if needed, places in a private directory, and exposes to the service via $CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY . The operator tool is systemd-creds . This guide is operational. Commands and behavior come from systemd-creds(1) , the Credentials section of systemd.exec(5) , and the upstream System and Service Credentials document. Examples target systemd 250+ (encryption tooling); user-scoped encrypt/decrypt needs 256+.

articles.body: Diablo 4 director Brent Gibson is telling fans not to worry about the game after Diablo 5’s announcement sparked concerns about the former title’s lifespan. Diablo 5’s reveal at Blizzcon 2026 left fans equal parts excited and worried. Of course, players were pumped for a new Diablo game — but with Diablo 4 having just launched in 2023, the reveal of a new game so soon felt like a death knell for the one they were still playing. But Brent Gibson, director of Diablo 4, says there’s nothing to fuss about. Speaking with Icy Veins , Gibson outlined some plans for the game’s future content, saying it will continue to receive support well after 5’s release. “I have an analogy,” he began. “If you’re wearing a sign in the middle of Times Square saying, ‘The end is nigh,’ the end is not nigh.
